definitions.explanation: A local government administrative office where citizens handle official paperwork such as resident registration, certificates, and various permits.

examples.japanese: {住民票|じゅうみんひょう}を{取|と}りに{役所|やくしょ}へ{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to the government office to get my resident certificate.

examples.japanese: {役所|やくしょ}の{窓口|まどぐち}は{午後|ごご}{5時|ごじ}に{閉|し}まる。
examples.english: The government office counter closes at 5 PM.

examples.japanese: {引っ越|ひっこ}したら{役所|やくしょ}で{届|とど}け{出|で}をしなければならない。
examples.english: After moving, you must file a notification at the government office.

notes:
COMPOSITION: {役|やく} (role, service) + {所|しょ} (place). Literally "place of service."

TYPES OF LOCAL GOVERNMENT OFFICES:
・{市役所|しやくしょ} (city hall)
・{区役所|くやくしょ} (ward office)
・{町役場|まちやくば}/{村役場|むらやくば} (town/village office)
・{県庁|けんちょう} (prefectural office)

COMMON PROCEDURES AT {役所|やくしょ}:
・{住民票|じゅうみんひょう}の{発行|はっこう} (issuing resident certificate)
・{戸籍|こせき}{謄本|とうほん}の{取得|しゅとく} (obtaining family register copy)
・{転入届|てんにゅうとどけ}/{転出届|てんしゅつとどけ} (moving in/out notification)
・{印鑑登録|いんかんとうろく} (seal registration)
・{婚姻届|こんいんとどけ} (marriage registration)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{役所|やくしょ}に{届|とど}け{出|で}をする (to file a notification)
・{役所|やくしょ}で{手続|てつづ}きをする (to complete procedures)
・{役所|やくしょ}の{窓口|まどぐち} (government office counter)

USAGE NOTE:
{役所|やくしょ} is the general term for local government offices. In casual conversation, {市役所|しやくしょ} or {区役所|くやくしょ} may be shortened to just {役所|やくしょ}.
